public_body: Veterans And Friends Of The Edward Gourdin Statue Project
overall: The AG found the Veterans and Friends of Gourdin Memorial Park is a registered nonprofit not within government, so it is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law and could not have violated it; no further action was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Gourdin memorial park veterans group violated the Open Meeting Law; the AG first tested whether the nonprofit is a public body at all.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the above, we find that the VFGMP is not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law, and therefore could not have violated the Open Meeting Law.
